initiatives.name: Des Moines Catholic Worker
initiatives.description: Live-in Catholic Worker community in Des Moines that runs houses of hospitality and offers meals, a food pantry, clothing, and hygiene supplies, and does nonviolent peace activism.

initiatives.name: SURJ Des Moines
initiatives.description: Des Moines chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice, which organizes white Iowans on racial justice. Work groups cover racial justice education, immigration justice, and equity in education.

initiatives.name: Des Moines People's Town Hall
initiatives.description: Des Moines group that helps residents sign up to speak and email officials about Des Moines City Council meetings, focused on police abolition and anti-racism.

initiatives.name: Prison Abolition Coalition DSM
initiatives.description: Building solidarity with those incarcerated by the state of Iowa
